timing: Before new M14 physics/frontier or preference execution; M12/M13 results already known, not blinded or held out

service.comparison: each raw field/harvest cumulative crop ET deficit <= tolerance + 1e-8mm

calendar_policy.common_pool: Every scenario complete and hard arc/calendar/daily/annual admissible; same fixed15 comparator IDs in all9 states
calendar_policy.missing_case: NOT_COMPUTED, never zero; whole-domain conclusion unresolved if any potentially eligible candidate missing

units.ET: m3 equivalent = sum crop deficit_mm * area_ha *10
units.regret: m3 equivalent; per-scenario difference from best in same fixed common15; M12 half-even 1e-6m3 precision
units.source: m3 source withdrawal, gross/net loss separated
units.service: mm per field harvest year, not five-year irrigation volume

frontier.selection: M13 two robust criteria winners plus lexicographically first distinct calendar-valid existing candidate, no outcome-based alternate selection
frontier.service_grid_rule: 100 plus ceil((max raw field/harvest deficit -1e-8)/1e-6)*1e-6 and previous1e-6 for each representative/cap; report finite tested delivery grid, no supply monotonicity assumption
frontier.boundary_full_daily_probes: BASE for all3 representatives: both adjacent points × all3windows; M13 two additionally165.47 and165.48 on DRY_ANCHOR_2018
frontier.rain_zero: one labeled synthetic DRY case for alternate only, excluded from main9
frontier.classification: BRACKETED_RESEARCH_SENSITIVITY for service; CERTIFIED_MODEL_BOUND only fixed-access rainfed recurrence with witness and counterchecks

missing_N_yield_rights: field recommendation always BLOCKED; no hidden imputation
stop: G5 M14 only; no M15, UI, public endpoint, deployment or submissions
